summary: The Chaplin Public Library opposes proposals to sunset or limit E-Rate funding, restrict special construction or dark fiber services, extend CIPA to third-party-owned devices, and define covered E-Rate consultants. It emphasizes the critical role of E-Rate in maintaining affordable, reliable internet access for its rural community. The library and school district highlight the importance of E-Rate funding for maintaining essential services and access to reliable internet for education, communication, and community activities. They express concern about the impact of any reduction in funding on their ability to provide these services and maintain their community center role.
filer_raw: Lisa Nadile | Sandra Horning | Leslie Ricklin
